title: 政策托底与AI业绩支撑结构机会，加密风险偏好升温但A股宽度转弱
summary: 隔夜纳指上涨、AMD业绩与电气设备/电子元件走强利好算力及光通信映射；A股上一交易日宽度转弱、创业板跌2.73%，政策流动性托底与公司公告形成结构机会。

利好利空中性w1-w5 表示热度/重要性，不等于涨跌幅。
重大新闻汇总
国际
中东停火谈判仍远、油价延续回落
Reuters称美伊仍未接近结束冲突的协议，美国夜间袭击伊朗格什姆岛防空目标；Brent结算跌1.12%至103.60美元。油价回落利于航空、物流与下游制造成本，但地缘升级仍可快速逆转。来源：Reuters。
政策
千亿元互换便利继续托底资本市场
人民银行11月3日开展1000亿元证券、基金、保险公司互换便利操作；回购增持再贷款转为长期安排、利率降至1%。政策提升机构和产业资本的流动性，但不保证高估值题材同步上涨。来源：人民银行公告转录。
政策
外汇存款准备金率上调至6%
人民银行决定11月15日起将外汇存款准备金率由4%上调至6%，管理外汇流动性并抑制人民币单边升值预期；Reuters估算约抽回240亿美元外汇流动性。出口链汇兑压力可能缓和，但人民币资产外资情绪需观察。来源：人民银行消息、Reuters。
政策
发改委部署新兴支柱产业与“人工智能+”
国家发展改革委11月3日发布会覆盖新兴支柱产业、未来产业、“人工智能+”、数据要素和数字中国。对算力、数据基础设施和产业数字化形成中期支撑，短线仍需订单与价格确认。来源：国家发展改革委。
美股
AMD业绩超预期、半导体链反弹
AMD三季度营收134亿美元、调整后EPS 2.09美元，数据中心收入同比增97%；第四季度收入指引约170亿美元，高于市场预期。运行时公开延长时段报价AMD 483.90美元、较前收+3.73%，A/H映射聚焦服务器、先进封装、PCB和光通信。来源：AMD及运行时公开报价。
排行
电气设备与加密主题领涨、食品分销领跌
11月3日美股现金时段，电气设备及零件+5.76%、电子元件+4.02%，加密矿企+13.77%、加密储备+5.83%；食品分销-6.34%。电力设备、储能与光器件有A/H映射，加密主题未核验出直接A/H候选，禁止用情绪关联硬凑推荐。来源：GitHub Actions/Moomoo快照，08:32 CST。
公告
云南锗业签下磷化铟五年供货协议
子公司云南鑫耀与AOI约定2027至2031年每年预计供应18万片4英寸N型磷化铟衬底；2027年度合同金额1.944亿美元，约13.05亿元。实际交付取决于年度订单和出口许可证；11月3日收盘68.53元、跌5.08%，该价格早于盘后公告。来源：公司公告转录。
公告
游族网络拟采购42.25亿元GPU
全资子公司向未披露对手方采购PRO5500 GPU，合同额42.25亿元，约为公司2025年营收三倍；交付可随上游调整，资金来源和下游变现未充分披露。11月3日收盘10.72元、跌4.96%，价格同样早于盘后公告。来源：巨潮资讯公告。
公告
威胜信息中标电网项目约2.31亿元
公司披露南方电网、国家电网等六项中标或预中标合计2.31亿元，占2025年营收7.75%；部分项目尚未签正式合同。11月3日收盘25.86元、涨0.82%，早于盘后披露，今日需观察量价确认。来源：上交所公告页。
回报
东山精密控股股东提议强化股东回报
控股股东提议未来三年股东回报安排，2026年度现金分红及回购合计不低于10亿元；该提议并非董事会决议，仍需董事会和股东会审议。11月3日收盘88.13元、跌4.41%。来源：巨潮资讯公告。
财报
百胜中国营收与利润增长、同店仍承压
三季度营收34.77亿美元、同比增8%，经营利润4.51亿美元、增13%，摊薄EPS 0.91美元、增20%；同店销售为上年同期97%。运行时YUMC报价47.85美元、较前收+1.61%，业绩获正面反馈但客单价压力仍在。来源：港交所公告及运行时公开报价。
市场
A股宽度转弱、港股消费相对占优
11月3日上证跌0.82%、创业板跌2.73%，上涨2108家、下跌3309家；恒指涨0.57%、恒生科技涨0.74%，消费强于光通信和芯片。AKShare最新快照仍停在11月2日，当日A股4470涨/788跌、中位数+1.955%的强势仅作历史基线，不能代替11月3日收盘。来源：公开收盘数据与AKShare历史快照。

美股夜盘行情总结

夜盘指数
延长时段ETF代理维持科技强、道指弱
运行时公开报价截至08:17-08:18 CST：QQQ 685.28美元、较前收+0.63%；SPY 754.35美元、+0.30%；DIA 517.06美元、-0.44%。三者为延长时段ETF代理，涨跌为相对前收的累计变化，数据源未拆分收盘后单独增量。
板块对照
强势组大体获确认、弱势组代表股出现背离
行业Top5代表股STI +20.10%、ARRY +22.37%、YDKG +15.73%、SCNX +4.64%、FN +15.58%，均确认正向；Bottom5代表股PLBL +2.72%、SOC +0.61%、EPSM +8.31%、BXBL +3.88%、MTEX +2.52%均与所属行业负向相反，属于潜在反转/个股背离。概念Top5中RIOT +18.50%、BTBT +15.39%、CLSK +14.06%、ARTL +7.37%确认正向，MTWO报价不可得。报价时间为06:35-08:19 CST。
A/H 映射
科技反弹利于结构修复、加密主题不直接外推
AMD、电子元件和电气设备的同向信号利于服务器、PCB、光器件、电网设备开盘修复；但11月3日A股宽度偏弱，需以创业板止跌和相关标的站上前收确认。加密主题虽强，因缺少已核验的直接A/H业务敞口，不转化为股票推荐。

盘前结论

稳市工具与“人工智能+”政策提供中期托底，隔夜AMD业绩、电子元件和电气设备走强，为A/H算力、光器件、电网设备和储能带来结构性修复窗口。

11月3日A股上涨家数明显少于下跌家数，创业板跌2.73%、科创与通信硬件承压，说明外部科技反弹尚未转化为本地广泛风险偏好；外汇准备金率上调也会增加短线汇率变量。

开盘策略以事件驱动和价格确认优先：云南锗业、威胜信息、百胜中国列条件关注；游族网络因超大额采购、资金与变现不确定性列回避。若创业板继续弱于上证或候选跌破11月3日收盘价，修复逻辑失效。

重点个股关注

云南锗业
002428.SZ
条件关注

事实与状态：磷化铟长期协议直接映射数据中心光器件上游，2027年度合同约13.05亿元；11月3日收盘68.53元、跌5.08%，该价格早于盘后公告，尚无公告后确认。

确认条件：开盘后站回68.53元并放量，且出口许可与年度订单进展无不利变化。

风险与失效：实际交付依赖订单和出口许可，扩产、良率与成本可能影响利润；跌破11月3日低点或许可受阻即失效。

威胜信息
688100.SH
条件关注

事实与状态：六项电网中标或预中标合计2.31亿元，占2025年营收7.75%；11月3日收盘25.86元、涨0.82%，但公告后尚未交易。

确认条件：正式合同推进且开盘守住25.86元，电气设备板块维持相对强势。

风险与失效：部分项目尚未签约，收入确认与毛利率取决于交付；跌破25.65元前收并弱于电网设备板块即失效。

百胜中国
09987.HK / YUMC
条件关注

事实与状态：三季度营收、经营利润和EPS分别增长8%、13%和20%，运行时ADR报47.85美元、较前收+1.61%；同店销售仍仅为上年同期97%。

确认条件：港股开盘跟随ADR正反馈，09987.HK不跌破11月3日收盘并保持消费板块相对强势。

风险与失效：客单价下行、配送成本和加速开店的资本开支可能稀释利润；港股开盘与ADR背离即降级。

游族网络
002174.SZ
回避

事实与状态：42.25亿元GPU采购约为2025年营收三倍，交易对手未披露；三季度归母净利润为负，11月3日收盘10.72元、跌4.96%，尚无公告后价格反馈。

确认条件：只有资金来源、下游客户与收入合同、交付安排清晰，并在有效交易时段获得正面价格确认后才重新评估。

风险与失效：预付款、交期、上游调价及变现路径不确定，可能放大现金流和资产减值风险；当前不具备多头卡条件。

板块轮动看板

受益方向电网设备、储能、光器件上游；AMD业绩与FN大涨支撑算力链修复
观察方向券商与回购增持、百胜中国和港股消费；需用开盘量价确认
压力方向高估值创业板、食品分销与地产链；游族超大额采购风险
验证信号创业板止跌、电子/通信不再弱于指数，候选守住11月3日收盘价

逻辑链

互换便利与回购增持再贷款 → 提升机构和产业资本流动性 → 为A股下行提供缓冲。
AMD业绩超预期与电子元件上涨 → 映射服务器、PCB、光器件 → 观察云南锗业等事件股价格确认。
电气设备行业+5.76%与储能概念+4.69% → 映射电网数字化 → 威胜信息中标形成公司级催化。
A股11月3日宽度转弱 → 高贝塔科技承接不足 → 开盘不能只凭美股反弹追涨。
加密概念大涨但无直接A/H敞口 → 仅作为全球风险偏好观察 → 不生成情绪映射推荐。

风险雷达

A股宽度11月3日下跌家数3309家，高于上涨2108家，创业板跌2.73%。
公告执行云南锗业依赖出口许可和订单，威胜部分项目未签正式合同。
大额采购游族GPU合同规模显著高于现有营收，资金与下游变现路径未清晰。
汇率与地缘外汇准备金率调整叠加中东冲突，人民币、油价与外资风险偏好仍可能反复。
数据时效AKShare为11月2日历史快照；运行时美股代理为延长时段累计变化，非独立期指。

数据来源与时间点

研究截止2026-11-04 08:35 CST。国内发现源：财联社A股公告速递、东方财富四大证券报摘要；原始/法定来源：国家发展改革委、人民银行公告转录、巨潮资讯、上交所、港交所。美股：Reuters、AMD、GitHub Actions/Moomoo快照（2026-11-04 08:32 CST，覆盖11月3日现金时段）。运行时延长时段代理与代表股公开报价抓取于08:32-08:34 CST，行情时间06:35-08:19 CST；QQQ/SPY/DIA为ETF代理，涨跌相对前收。AKShare v1.18.94 fetchedAt 2026-11-02 14:05 CST：A股4470涨/788跌/75平、中位数+1.955%，港股999涨/757跌/1049平、中位数0%，仅作历史基线；11月3日收盘以公开市场数据交叉核验。

Major News Digest
Global
Middle East deal remains distant as oil eases
Reuters said the US and Iran remained far from an agreement, while US forces struck air-defense targets on Iran's Qeshm Island. Brent settled 1.12% lower at $103.60. Lower oil helps airlines, logistics and downstream manufacturers, but escalation can reverse the move quickly. Source: Reuters.
Policy
CNY100 billion swap facility supports equities
The PBOC conducted a CNY100 billion securities-fund-insurance swap operation on Nov 3; buyback relending became a standing arrangement with the rate cut to 1%. The tools improve liquidity for institutions and issuers but do not guarantee a broad rally in expensive themes. Source: PBOC notice transcript.
Policy
FX reserve requirement rises to 6%
The PBOC will raise banks' FX reserve ratio from 4% to 6% on Nov 15 to manage FX liquidity and discourage one-way yuan appreciation; Reuters estimates about $24 billion of FX liquidity will be absorbed. Exporters may see less translation pressure, while foreign-flow sensitivity bears watching. Sources: PBOC report and Reuters.
Policy
NDRC advances new pillars and AI Plus
The NDRC's Nov 3 briefing covered emerging pillar industries, future industries, AI Plus, data factors and Digital China. This supports compute, data infrastructure and industrial digitization over the medium term, but near-term trades still require orders and price confirmation. Source: NDRC.
US Tech
AMD beats as semiconductors rebound
AMD posted Q3 revenue of $13.4 billion and adjusted EPS of $2.09; data-center revenue rose 97% year over year. Its Q4 revenue outlook is about $17 billion, above consensus. The runtime extended-hours quote was $483.90, up 3.73% versus the prior close, mapping to A/H servers, advanced packaging, PCB and optical communications. Sources: AMD and runtime public quotes.
Ranking
Electrical equipment and crypto lead; food distribution lags
In the Nov 3 US cash session, electrical equipment rose 5.76%, electronic components 4.02%, crypto mining 13.77% and crypto treasury 5.83%, while food distribution fell 6.34%. Power equipment, storage and optical components map to A/H; no direct A/H crypto exposure was verified, so no sentiment-only pick is manufactured. Source: GitHub Actions/Moomoo snapshot at 08:32 CST.
Filing
Yunnan Germanium signs five-year InP agreement
Yunnan Xinyao and AOI expect annual supply of 180,000 four-inch N-type InP substrates from 2027 to 2031; the 2027 contract is $194.4 million, about CNY1.305 billion. Delivery depends on annual orders and export permits. The Nov 3 close was CNY68.53, down 5.08%, before the after-hours filing. Source: filing transcript.
Filing
Yoozoo plans CNY4.225 billion GPU purchase
A wholly owned unit will buy PRO5500 GPUs from an undisclosed counterparty for CNY4.225 billion, about three times 2025 revenue. Delivery can shift with upstream schedules, while funding and downstream monetization remain insufficiently disclosed. The Nov 3 close was CNY10.72, down 4.96%, before the filing. Source: CNINFO filing.
Filing
Willfar wins about CNY231 million of grid projects
The company disclosed six awards or preferred-bidder notices from China Southern Grid, State Grid and others totaling CNY231 million, or 7.75% of 2025 revenue; some contracts are not yet signed. The Nov 3 close was CNY25.86, up 0.82%, before the filing, leaving today's tape as the confirmation test. Source: SSE filing page.
Returns
Dongshan controlling holders propose stronger returns
The controlling shareholders proposed a three-year return arrangement, with at least CNY1 billion of 2026 dividends plus buybacks. It is not a board resolution and still needs board and shareholder approvals. The stock closed Nov 3 at CNY88.13, down 4.41%. Source: CNINFO filing.
Earnings
Yum China grows profit while same-store sales lag
Q3 revenue rose 8% to $3.477 billion, operating profit 13% to $451 million and diluted EPS 20% to $0.91; same-store sales were 97% of the prior-year level. YUMC was $47.85, up 1.61% versus the prior close at runtime, showing positive feedback with ticket pressure intact. Sources: HKEX filing and runtime public quotes.
Market
A-share breadth weakens while Hong Kong consumption leads
On Nov 3, the Shanghai Composite fell 0.82% and ChiNext 2.73%, with 2,108 advancers versus 3,309 decliners; the HSI rose 0.57% and HSTECH 0.74%, as consumption outperformed optical hardware and chips. AKShare's latest snapshot remains Nov 2: 4,470 A-share advancers/788 decliners and a +1.955% median are historical context, not the Nov 3 close.

US Overnight Trading Summary

Overnight Indexes
Extended-hours ETF proxies keep tech firm and the Dow weak
Runtime public quotes at 08:17-08:18 CST: QQQ $685.28, +0.63% versus the prior close; SPY $754.35, +0.30%; DIA $517.06, -0.44%. These are extended-hours ETF proxies showing cumulative changes versus the prior close; the source does not isolate a separate post-close leg.
Sector Check
Strong groups are confirmed while weak-group leaders diverge
Industry Top5 leaders STI +20.10%, ARRY +22.37%, YDKG +15.73%, SCNX +4.64% and FN +15.58% confirm positive direction. Bottom5 leaders PLBL +2.72%, SOC +0.61%, EPSM +8.31%, BXBL +3.88% and MTEX +2.52% move opposite their negative industries, a potential reversal/stock-level divergence. Concept leaders RIOT +18.50%, BTBT +15.39%, CLSK +14.06% and ARTL +7.37% confirm positive direction; MTWO is unavailable. Quote times span 06:35-08:19 CST.
A/H Mapping
Tech rebound favors selective repair; crypto is not extrapolated
AMD, electronic components and electrical equipment favor an opening repair in servers, PCB, optical components and grid equipment. Yet Nov 3 A-share breadth was weak, so ChiNext stabilization and candidates holding above the prior close are required. Crypto is strong, but without verified direct A/H business exposure it does not become a stock pick.

Pre-market Conclusion

Stabilization tools and AI Plus policy provide medium-term support, while AMD's results and gains in electronic components and electrical equipment create a selective repair window for A/H compute, optical components, grid equipment and storage.

On Nov 3, A-share decliners exceeded advancers and ChiNext fell 2.73%, showing that the overseas tech rebound has not yet translated into broad local risk appetite. The higher FX reserve ratio also adds a near-term currency variable.

Prioritize event-driven setups with price confirmation: Yunnan Germanium, Willfar Information and Yum China are conditional watches; Yoozoo is an avoid because of the outsized purchase and funding/monetization uncertainty. If ChiNext remains weaker than the Shanghai Composite or candidates lose their Nov 3 closes, the repair thesis fails.

Key Stocks

Yunnan Germanium
002428.SZ
Conditional Watch

Facts and status: The InP agreement directly maps to upstream data-center optics, with a 2027 contract worth about CNY1.305 billion. The Nov 3 close was CNY68.53, down 5.08%, before the filing, so there is no post-filing confirmation.

Confirmation: Reclaim CNY68.53 on volume after the open, with no adverse change to export permits or annual orders.

Risk and invalidation: Delivery depends on orders and permits; expansion, yields and costs can affect profit. A break of the Nov 3 low or permit blockage invalidates the setup.

Willfar Information
688100.SH
Conditional Watch

Facts and status: Six grid awards or preferred-bidder notices total CNY231 million, 7.75% of 2025 revenue. The Nov 3 close was CNY25.86, up 0.82%, but trading predates the filing.

Confirmation: Formal contracts advance, the stock holds CNY25.86 after the open and electrical equipment retains relative strength.

Risk and invalidation: Some projects are unsigned, while revenue and margin depend on delivery. A break below the CNY25.65 prior close with sector underperformance invalidates the setup.

Yum China
